jei.quantumcraft.qblock: An Essence of Observation (Observer Dependent Block) or of Superposition (Quantum Block) in the crafting grid, with up to six blocks around it: above it the north side, below it the south side, left the west side, right the east side, upper left the top and lower left the bottom. Empty places show nothing. The block shows the side it is looked at from; a Quantum Block may show the opposite one. Players wearing a pumpkin or Quantum Goggles do not observe.
jei.quantumcraft.entangled: An Essence of Entanglement between two equal qBlocks or two Quantum Computers gives two entangled ones (a new group). Entangled blocks are observed together.
jei.quantumcraft.quantum_computer: Teleports the area inside a frame: four qBlocks in the computer's layer, up to 8 blocks away in each direction, made of obsidian with gold on the side facing the computer; obsidian pillars above and below them and glass on top of the pillars. Needs ice next to it for cooling. Blocks with block entities cannot be moved. A single computer swaps the area with the one it stored; entangled computers swap their areas.
jei.quantumcraft.quantum_goggles: Shows the superposition of qBlocks; the wearer does not observe them.
jei.quantumcraft.quantum_ore: Glows when touched. Found deep underground (below y 24).
